about.title: About me
about.p1: I am a mechatronics engineer based in Bavaria, Germany, with more than ten years of experience in the design of mechatronic systems. I hold two master's degrees, in mechatronics and in instrumentation.
about.p2: I have worked in regulated engineering environments, where traceability, documentation and quality matter as much as the technical solution. Outside of work I build my own hardware and software projects, from embedded sensors to Android apps and VR simulations.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Selected personal projects: hardware, firmware and software.

items.title: Smart Exercise Motion Tracker
items.desc: A wearable device that tracks exercise motion and turns it into performance analytics. ESP32-C3 and an MPU6050 motion sensor, paired with an Android app.

items.title: VR Scooter Simulator
items.desc: A virtual-reality scooter simulator built in Unity, with a Python launcher and a dedicated controller layer for riding physics.

items.title: PDF Tablet Annotator
items.desc: An Android app for annotating PDFs with a stylus on a tablet, written in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose.

items.title: Handwriting to CNC
items.desc: My own handwriting digitised into vector glyphs and a font, then reproduced by a CNC pen plotter through generated G-code.
